newsitem.title: USA: Group selling 4.7 mln Robertson-Ceco shrs.
newsitem.headline: Group selling 4.7 mln Robertson-Ceco shrs.

text.p: A group including Sage Capital Corp said Thursday it has agreed to sell 4.666 million common shares it holds in Robertson-Ceco Corp for $6 a share, or about $28 million, to Pettibone Corp.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said that under an August 20 agreement, Pettibone will buy the shares on a staggered basis beginning September 30, but could accelarate the purchase by giving 10 days' prior notice.
When the deal is completed, the group said its stake will be reduced to 4.9 percent or 796,347 shares.
